title: Mayor Gloria Highlights Progress on Cleaning Up Encampments along Freeways Around Downtown
description: SAN DIEGO – Roughly 90 days into an agreement that Mayor Todd Gloria reached with the California Department of Transportation (Caltrans) that allows City workers to address unsafe and unsanitary encampments along a portion of state freeways, the Mayor details the progress the City has made in clearing encampments, disposing of garbage and debris, and connecting encampment residents with shelter and housing.
